title: High School Isekai
description:
Your entire class has been summoned to the fantasy world of Eldora, and have each been given unique abilities. However, you might have some other unexpected changes as well...

-Overcome challenges and defy all odds to defeat the demon king and return home (though a surprise awaits you once you do)

-Focused, interconnected story cards allow the story to progress seamlessly without any corrective input needed from the player, while also taking up little memory. 

-Enjoy a tightly wrapped story designed to work well even with free models. 

UPDATE: AUTO-CARDS ADDED, courtesy of @LewdLeah
prompt:
You are ${name}, an all-around unremarkable high school student. One day, while playing on your phone in class, you hear one of your classmates suddenly shout, "what on Earth is that?!?!" Just as you try to see what they're looking at, a bright light suddenly envelops the classroom, blinding you. 

For a moment, there is nothing but silence, but then, as your vision returns, you also hear the groans of your classmates. The first thing you notice is that you are in a huge castle, in what appears to be a throne room. You look around, and see that all of your classmates are unharmed, but your teacher isn't here.

Before anyone gets a chance to talk, a booming voice carries across the room, as an old, stocky human man stands up from the throne. "Greetings, brave heroes from another world! We have summoned you all here to the world of Eldora, in order to save our kingdom!"

"What's going on?! What are you talking about?" Jacob yells out, finally getting his bearings. The castle guards raise their swords in unison, but King Maric waves his hand, and they sheathe their swords. 

"I understand you are all confused, but be not afraid. For each of you have been given powerful gifts that will aid us in our fight. You will be trained by the best of the best, and you will be provided everything you need, including guest rooms in the castle." King Maric speaks, his booming voice leaving no room for argument amongst your classmates. "Follow the guards; they will take you to the testing hall to determine your ability."

You can tell that several of your classmates want to speak up, but they all hold their tongues. You quietly follow the guards to the testing hall along with the others.

Entering the testing hall, you find that it is more like a bunker, with solid concrete on all sides. In the center of the room is a magic crystal. Each of your classmates are guided to place their hands on it, and one by one they learn their unique skill. The geeks and jocks both seem to be almost excited upon discovering what their skill is, while everyone else just appears nervous and confused.
Finally, you are up last to the crystal. You hesitate, before placing your hands on the crystal. The crystal suddenly glows a blinding white, that temporarily blinds you and everyone else. Just as the crystal starts to crack, you yank your hand away, and the light dies down. You pant heavily, looking around to see everyone's reaction. While the guards seem to be in awe, your classmates seem to be staring way too much. Something feels off, and you stumble backwards as you see your reflection in the testing crystal.
memory:
You are ${name}, a ${choose the gender you'd like to be} (originally ${your original gender}) ${race} (originally human). You and your 15 classmates have been summoned to the world of Eldora, in the Kingdom of Alria.

Your classmates are:
1. Jocks: Mike, Sam, Natalie
2. Nerds: Ben, Nate, Sarah
3. Popular kids: Chris, Jenny
4. Geeks: Ryan, Ollie, Lily
5. Delinquents: Jacob, Kayla
6. Others: Alex, Emily
Your unique skill is ${name of your unique skill}, which ${describe what your unique skill does}.
instructions:
Instructions: 
- The "Enter the Dungeon" event story card always occurs no more than 5 inputs after the story begins. 
- Never repeat entire sentences. Avoid repetition and repetitive tropes. 
- Allow classmates to use their unique skills whenever it makes sense.
- Allow classmates to get injured or die.

cardPool.title: Mike
cardPool.value:
Mike is the tallest and strongest of your classmates, having been the star football player of the school. His unique gift enhances his strength and durability to absurd amounts. Although he isn't particularly fast, he can easily tank attacks and push right through.
Personality: Mike is standoffish, rude, and arrogant.

cardPool.title: Sam
cardPool.value:
Sam is the leader of the track team. He is tall and lean, with a pretty face and soft voice that could be mistaken for a girl's at first glance. Sam's unique skill gives him unparalleled speed and endurance, allowing him to easily dodge any attack and run long distances in the blink of an eye, making him an ideal scout.
Personality: Sam is girlish and feminine, and is a closeted gay guy. He has an unrequited crush on Mike, who is straight and can't return his feelings. Despite this, any girl who catches Mike's attention earns his ire.

cardPool.title: Natalie
cardPool.value:
Natalie is the star volleyball player. She is the tallest girl in your class, with dirty blonde hair, a lithe body, and flat chest and butt. Natalie's unique skill allows her to reflect any physical or magical attack back on the attacker for twice the damage, as long as the attack doesn't come from a blind spot.
Personality: Natalie is Tsundere, and she secretly likes the player. She is also insecure about her flat chest and butt.

cardPool.title: Ben
cardPool.value:
Ben is the highest achieving student in your class, earning perfect grades. He is short, with poor eyesight, and is often bullied by others in your class due to jealousy and because his small stature makes him an easy target. Ben's unique skill affords him all the knowledge in Eldora, which unfortunately for him doesn't help him against his classmates. 
Personality: Ben is timid and has low self-esteem. He tends to keep to himself and is wary of kindness.

cardPool.title: Nathan
cardPool.value:
Nate is the vice president of the student council. His grades, while not perfect, are impressive, but where he excels is not in book smarts but in planning. He is a natural-born tactician. He is average height, and his looks are fairly good. Nate's unique skill is foresight, allowing him to see the future by interacting with objects of importance.
Personality: Nate is clever and scheming. Because of this, the jocks tend to leave him alone and the popular kids pretend to get along with him to benefit from him. However, his personality and greed is awful, and his morality while beginning as neutral is easy to turn to evil.

cardPool.title: Sarah
cardPool.value:
Sarah is a quiet girl who does well in her studies, particularly in math. She is short, with a freckled face and red hair. Although she has a large chest and butt, no one would know this due to the modest clothes she wears. Sarah's unique skill allows her to use any type of magic, which when combined with her talent for math, makes her a genius sage that can cast spells in half the time of any other sage. 
Personality: Despite her timid nature, she is friendly and gets along well with other girls. However, she has a complex about her freckles, making her terrified of interacting with boys.

cardPool.title: Chris
cardPool.value:
Chris is the son of two popular models. He has unrivaled looks, being tall without being too tall, lean, has beautiful eyes, flawless skin, and flowing golden hair. Chris's unique skill makes him able to charm any female humanoid monster through eye contact, making them completely obedient puppets under his control.
Personality: Chris has a deceiving personality. Though he always acts friendly and kind in person, he is extremely selfish, attention-seeking, and controlling in actuality, due to his upbringing with parents that hardly paid attention to him.

cardPool.title: Jenny
cardPool.value:
Jenny is the most popular girl in school. She has long, flowing pink hair, dazzling purple eyes, perfect skin, and unbelievable proportions. Jenny's unique skill makes her an unrivaled saintess, able to completely regrow limbs and bring a person back from the brink of death, as well as lift curses and create powerful magic barriers. 
Personality: Jenny is extremely dumb and oblivious. She means well, but due to her low intelligence she often makes things worse. Despite this, her bubbly personality makes her the most popular girl in school.

cardPool.title: Ryan
cardPool.value:
Ryan is the founder of the gaming club. He is tall and lanky, kind of goofy looking, and he doesn't really take care of his appearance. If he were to have his appearance taken care of, he might be popular with the girls. He loves all sorts of games, but especially loves RPG games. Because of this, he is excited about being Isekai'd. Ryan's unique skill makes him a master swordsman, able to go toe to toe with superior dragons even on his own.
Personality: Ryan is awkward and goofy, often saying weird things or missing social cues. Despite this, he is fairly likeable because of his easygoing nature.

cardPool.title: Ollie
cardPool.value:
Ollie, despite the masculine name, is actually a girl. She is average height, a bit chubby, and has short black hair. She has an androgynous appearance. She loves romance manga, especially ones with two girls. Ollie's unique skill allows her to take on the form of a handsome man with incredible luck. Despite having only minor increases in her stats when transformed into a man, her luck gives her what can only be described as plot armor, turning even dangerous situations into romantic ones, with her ending up always somehow saving a girl from danger.
Personality: Ollie is tomboyish and blunt, unabashed about her strange interests. She secretly wishes she were a boy.

cardPool.title: Lily
cardPool.value:
Lily is a huge fan of anime, especially cute anime. She is the shortest girl in your class, and has a really cute, girly appearance. She often cosplays as her favorite anime characters. Lily's unique skill allows her to turn into a magical girl similar to her favorite anime, making her nearly invincible and extremely powerful. However, the skill only lasts for 15 minutes, and requires an hour before it can be used again. Her skill often runs out at inopportune times.
Personality: Lily is talkative and annoying, but also very cute. She loves anything cute, no matter what. She likes to reference her favorite anime, even when no one understands the reference.

cardPool.title: Jacob
cardPool.value:
Jacob is the biggest troublemaker in your class. He is average height, but well built, and has experience fighting. He has a scar on his neck. He is a bully. Jacob's unique skill allows him to go berserk, giving him inhuman strength and speed, but at the cost of conscious control over his actions, meaning he attacks anyone nearby with no distinction between friend and foe.
Personality: Jacob has a short temper, and vents his anger on those weaker than him. He's actually secretly an extremely fearful person. He grew up in a rough part of town, so he has learned to act tough as a way to protect himself.

cardPool.title: Kayla
cardPool.value:
Kayla is well known for being a druggie. She often steals  from stores to pay for her next fix. She often appears haggard, with dark circles under her eyes. She has a goth look and style. Kayla's unique skill allows her to permanently steal skills from monsters, making her less human as the time goes on. However, using her ability feels euphoric, so she can't help but crave more. 
Personality: Kayla is extremely sluggish and tired when she isn't craving her next fix. When she is under withdrawal, she becomes extremely irritable and will do whatever it takes to get her next fix.

cardPool.title: Alex
cardPool.value:
Alex is the very definition of average. Average grades, average height, average build, average personality. He comes from an average family, and really only shows extreme emotion when it involves his little sister, who he is overprotective of. Alex's unique skill gives him the ability to block any damage done to himself and anyone he's touching, as long as he doesn't run out of mana.
Personality: overprotective of those he cares about, but otherwise average and normal.

cardPool.title: Emily
cardPool.value:
Emily is a transfer student that transferred to your school this year. She is a typical looking girl for her age with brunette hair and a country girl vibe. Emily's unique skill allows her to shapeshift into a Fenrir, a legendary beast, granting her an extraordinary sense of smell, as well as enhanced speed, strength, and the ability to teleport short distances with shadow magic, as well as moderately strong ice magic. She can use a tenth of this power in human form; only keeping the fluffy tail and ears to distinguish her from a normal human.
Personality: Emily is a people pleaser by nature, even willing to sacrifice her own happiness in order to make others happy. Because of this, she suffers from depression, though she always hides it in front of others with a friendly facade.

cardPool.title: King Maric
cardPool.value:
King Maric, whose full name is Henry Maric, is the current king of Alria. He is the one who ordered the summoning ritual that brought your class over to the world of Eldora.
Personality: King Maric's personality appears suspicious and shifty, but he's actually a very kind and thoughtful king in reality. He seems unapproachable, and can be extremely intimidating, but he is very accommodating to any requests, since he feels bad about having to resort to summoning teenage kids from another world. 
King Maric, upon learning that the Demon King is trying to kill his summoned heroes, decides to send you all to Exper immediately.

cardPool.title: Princess Luma
cardPool.value:
Princess Luma, whose full name is Luma Maric, is the daughter of King Maric. Being an only child, with her mother passing away when she was young, she was most influenced by her father and the knights. Due do this upbringing, she became much more like a boy that a girl, only interested in getting stronger and fighting with her fists. Despite her frail looking appearance, she once eradicated an entire group of bandits on her own with nothing but her fists, earning her the nickname, "the bloodlust princess." 
Personality: Princess Luma is a boyish battle junkie. She only takes interest in those who offer her a challenge in a fight. She has never once lost a one on one fight, so if she loses, she will become extremely attracted to whoever beats her.

cardPool.title: Enter the dungeon
cardPool.value: Directly after everyone's unique skill is assessed, a suspicious, cloaked man will whisper something to King Maric. King Maric then immediately orders everyone into an artificial dungeon named Exper.

cardPool.title: Exper
cardPool.value: Exper is an artificial dungeon made by King Maric's Royal Mages. The dungeon utilizes golems to simulate an actual dungeon with none of the risk, since the golems are programmed not to kill. However, someone within the Royal Mages is a saboteur working for the Demon King, and upon learning that the summoned heros entered the dungeon, overwrote the programming of the dungeon. Now, the golems aim to kill.

cardPool.title: Exper Floor 1
cardPool.value: The first location after entering Exper, Exper Floor 1 consists of indestructible pure synthetic orichalcum walls, ceiling, and floor. There are three synthetic golems that are identical in appearance to live goblins. They are ordinarily designed to give up after taking sufficient damage, but for some reason their programming is wrong and they attempt to kill you and your classmates. To defeat them, you have to find and destroy their cores. After defeating all of the golems, you are warped to Exper Floor 2.

cardPool.title: Exper Floor 2
cardPool.value: Exper Floor 2, just like the first floor, consists entirely of synthetic orichalcum. However, the room is shaped like a tunnel. There are 10 golems that look exactly like demon wolves, that chase you and your classmates through the tunnel. Their limbs can move unlike normal joints, and they end up appearing horrifying, moving more like spiders. They can also walk on the walls and ceiling. This floor can be defeated by either getting to the end of the tunnel, or by defeating the wolves. However, there are 20 of them, and they intelligently work together trying to pick off the weakest links while avoiding stronger ones. After either reaching the end or destroying all 20 golems, you are warped to Exper Boss Room.

cardPool.title: Exper Boss Room
cardPool.value: The Exper Boss Room is a small chamber made of synthetic Orichalcum, which is well lit compared to the two previous floors. In the center of the room, there is an artificial wyvern golem. The golem is incredibly fast, strong, and durable, requiring everyone to work together in order to beat it. During the fight, the wyvern will cryptically repeat the phrase "For the King," repeatedly. Though to you and your classmates, who are already suspicious of King Maric, appears as if he were trying to sacrifice you all, the wyvern golem is actually referring to the demon king. After defeating the wyvern golem, you and your classmates are warped to the Lost Forest.

cardPool.title: The Lost Forest
cardPool.value: The Lost Forest is the origin of all magic in the world of Eldora, with all plants and trees there capable of transforming sunlight into mana. Normally, the World Tree, Elda, would be producing the most amount of magic, but for some reason, she is producing Miasma instead. Approaching her triggers the Versus Elda event.

cardPool.title: Versus Elda
cardPool.value: After defeating the dungeon boss, your entire class is teleported to the lost Forest. The World Tree, Elda, is releasing a sinister miasma. This Miasma has mutated all the wildlife that normally guards the world tree into half-demons. There are 3 wolves with horns and eight legs that are best in speed and attack. There is a bear with two heads, covered in poisonous spikes, that excels in defense and paralytics. There are 2 deer with fungi growing out of their bodies, and ten extra eyes, that excel in magic. Upon purifying the miasma, trigger the Elda Saved event.

cardPool.title: Elda Saved
cardPool.value: After purifying the Miasma, Elda and the demonized animals will return to their normal selves, and greet you all in spirit form. She will feel pity upon you all for being just children and yet being put through this. However, she reveals to you all that the demon king tricked her. She explains that over the course of the last few years, she has noticed pollution getting worse in both the air and the great river that flows through the forest. The demon king had stoked her distrust of humans, and offered to cast a spell that would protect the forest. Elda explains that she was blinded by rage, making her unable to realize she was being tricked until it was too late, and her rage was used to demonize her along with her guardian animals. She thanks you all for saving her, and gives you all her blessing, which provides essentially limitless mana to you and all your classmates.

cardPool.title: Elda
cardPool.value: Elda is the ancient spirit of the world tree, the origin of magic in Eldora. Elda has an inherent distrust of humans, but is kind to all creation.

cardPool.title: The Demon General
cardPool.value: After saving Elda and leaving the protection of the Lost Forest, the Demon King's underling, Demon General Neosmus intercepts you all, having noticed the purification of the Lost Forest and intending to defeat whoever dared interfered with her Majesty the demon king's great plans. Neosmus is a Lich Necromancer, leading an army of thousands of powerful undead monsters. He rides on a massive Skeleton Dragon. Defeating him requires taking out the skeleton dragon, and then locating and destroying his phylactery within the dragon's left eye. After defeating him, you head back to the capital.

cardPool.title: Neosmus
cardPool.value: Neosmus is the most powerful Lich, serving under the Demon King as her Demon General. Neosmus is a genius that can summon hordes of undead, a skeleton dragon, and still have brainpower to spare for his own dark magic attacks and debuff spells. Neosmus was once a priest that had been executed for sacrificing orphans to increase his own magic power. Feeling wronged by humanity, he awoke as a lich and pledged loyalty to the demon king, wanting to destroy humanity and gain power at any cost.

cardPool.title: The Capital of Alria
cardPool.value: After defeating the Demon General Neosmus, you and your classmates rush back to the Capital of Alria to find it under siege by the demon king and her forces. Princess Luma is on the front lines, but heavily injured, and only a portion of the knights remain alive. Just as you arrive, King Maric saves his daughter Luma by jumping in front of her, dying to the Demon King's disintegration spell.

cardPool.title: The Siege of Alria
cardPool.value: Upon arriving in the Capital of Alria, You and your classmates find the best fighters on their last legs. Just as they think they've lost, Jenny casts an area heal spell on all the allied forces. Nate uses foresight, and immediately gets Alex to protect Jenny, as the Demon King immediately tries to take out the healer. Chris is able to charm and control the succubi, turning them against their master. Emily transforms into her Fenrir form, and rushes in to battle the Cerberus. Ollie turns into her male form and Joins her. Mike overpowers a wyvern, catching its beak from a dive attack, and suplexing it, then using its body as a weapon. Sam runs around, moving people out of the way of any attacks before they can land. Natalie redirects magic attacks from the lesser demons back at the attackers. Lily turns into her magical girl form and takes on the vampire lord. Sarah uses her magic to bombard the enemy forces. Kayla steals skills in real time. Ryan uses his sword. Jacob goes berserk.

cardPool.title: Demon King Bellatrix
cardPool.value:
Demon King Bellatrix, commonly referred to as "Trixie", is an exceptionally pureblood demon of royal lineage. She possesses unique disintegration magic, nearly unlimited magical power, exceptional speed, defense, and physical attack, and can regenerate from anything in seconds so long as her magic core isn't broken. She is a deceptive creature that will use any means necessary to acquire power.
After killing her, trigger the defeat the demon king event.

cardPool.title: Defeat Demon King Bellatrix
cardPool.value: Upon shattering the core of the Demon King, the rest of the monsters are easily defeated. After finishing the remaining monsters, Jenny heals everyone, and even resurrects King Maric, causing an emotional reunion between him and Princess Luma. After all is said and done, King Maric thanks you all for saving their kingdom, and the Royal mages cast a circle to send you all back home. Trigger the Back Home event.

cardPool.title: Back Home
cardPool.value: After defeating the demon king and her army, You and your classmates are sent back to Earth, to the same point in time when you were summoned, in the middle of class. Everyone is turned back to normal, but for some reason, you remain the same as you were in the other world, retaining your abilities and any physical changes.
